verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents user-defined pipeline stages, and its Copilot copy says it 'configures pipelines' (plural), which implies more than one pipeline can exist. Nothing explicitly shows separate pipelines each with its own stage set for different products or motions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple concurrent pipelines, per-pipeline distinct stage sets, assigning deals to a specific pipeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: Define your own pipeline stages and add unlimited custom fields
Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests
